scope: Read-only design review. No new native authority, migration, checkpoint or financial task has been created.

sourceScopes.record: manager-validated actual fee credit and fixed transfer to Automation
complete asset-specific inflow/outflow lots, actual swap inputs, source bridge submission and refunds
all canonical inflows/outflows, including non-Forwarder spending
all canonical inflows and Executed from all callers

checkpoints.before: first Base fee transfer into Automation
requirements: Base Automation asset balances and canonical starting block
RH Treasury WETH balance and canonical starting block
existing shared Vault WETH balance and canonical starting block
checkpoints.openingBalances: unknown source until separately supported by complete prior evidence
checkpoints.writer: one canonical authority per chain; Base does not sign RH calls or initialize/write the RH ledger

sourceProof: Collector transfer must match actual recorded manager fee income; donations and untracked balances are not Base fees.
Automation can mix other income and deposits. Trace actual asset-specific fee lots into each supported source swap/deposit; counterfactual same address is not account identity proof.
Each Relay job must retain its native task/provider version, original order/request and source parameters or their exact hashes with recoverable data.
Verify canonical source account transaction/UserOperation and exact consumed assets; match the same provider order to the canonical destination payout in RH canonical WETH.
API DONE, timeout, 404, UI history or one matching amount cannot independently establish bridge completion or refund.
Unsupported/ambiguous native route or batch mapping stays unknown; do not fabricate source provenance from a Treasury balance.

treasuryFifo.cover: all Treasury WETH deposits and withdrawals, not only Forwarder calls or the recent list
treasuryFifo.consumption: FIFO across Base, RH, donation, profit and unknown lots
treasuryFifo.propagation: only a canonical fixed Forwarder event paired with its actual Treasury-to-Vault WETH transfer propagates provenance
treasuryFifo.mixedTransfer: split a Vault inflow into stable source fragments; every fragment sum must equal the canonical transfer amount
treasuryFifo.identity: transaction hash + transfer log index + stable partIndex
treasuryFifo.priorUnknown: older unknown Treasury lots can be consumed before new Base lots; Base may remain pending after an equal-size forwarding call

vaultFifo.consumption: reuse complete Vault FIFO with propagated source fragments and all public third-party Executed events
vaultFifo.attribution: allocate actual museToDead in proportion to WETH consumption, with exact conservation and separate caller profit
vaultFifo.description: FIFO accounting attribution; no on-chain segregation and no claim that ERC20 totalSupply decreased
vaultFifo.evidence: canonical Executed plus matching MUSEGOD Transfer to dead

recovery: Keyset full histories, canonical block hashes, CAS journal updates, reorg rewind/replay and backups.
Persist signed transaction hash before broadcast where project-owned calls are signed; unknown never authorizes repeated source spending.
Native server submissions are observed source tasks: absence of a project broadcast journal is not proof of failure.
Count a refund as usable only after canonical receipt, actual balance change and unambiguous provider job/asset mapping.
Keep native ETH refunds distinct from Base/RH canonical WETH and from 8-decimal B20 credits.
Interpret prior Across jobs by their original protocol/version; do not relabel them as native Relay jobs.
currentCodeGap: Existing direct Collector-to-Vault Across proof is not a native Relay/Treasury proof.
Current one-source Vault transfer classification cannot represent a mixed Treasury Forwarder transfer.
Native Automation source identity, Relay order extraction, Treasury all-outflow journal and stable provenance fragments require implementation after the source-policy decision.
